title: Volume rendering in WebGL
abstract:
I have: 
 
 a 3D array containing a 3d dataset to be displayed 
 a 4x4 matrix which defines spacing/scaling/orientation of the volume to be displayed 
 a opacity transfer function 
 a color transfer function 
 
 I would like to use ThreeJS to do volume rendering (MIP, RayCasting, etc.) of this data. What WebGL shaders must be created to fulfil the task? References on existing implementations are welcome, but only as a supplement for your answer. 
 Should I work directly at the shader level or in javascript?
